move: rows slide in, each checked: circle fills, tick draws, underline runs
how: A dark stage with a dot grid, a left column (eyebrow, two-line title, description in masks) and a right list of five items each with a check circle, a masked label, an index and a bottom underline, plus a counter. Left text rises through masks (expo.out) and items slide in from x 60 with opacity (expo.out, 0.1 stagger). From 16% each item is checked 0.9s apart: the green fill scales in with back.out(2.5), the border recolours, the tick path draws 0 to 100% via DrawSVG (power2.out), the row flashes a green background and nudges x 8 with an elastic settle, the underline grows scaleX (expo.out) and the counter increments. At 66% the fills pulse scale 1.15 in a chase. At 90% items slide out from the last (power3.in), the left text flies up and the counter fades. Timeline duration is 10s.
adapt: Change the eyebrow, title, description and the item labels (any count, 0.9s apart), accent green; keep the fill/tick/underline 0.12s offsets and the elastic nudge.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the columns and items; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with checks at (0.16 + i*0.09)D and exit at 0.9D. The counter uses onStart/onReverseComplete and should become an onUpdate on a proxy tween; scope selectors to el.
caveats: the counter text is set from onStart/onReverseComplete callbacks, which are not seek-safe when scrubbing
the dot grid fades in from 0 but stays visible at the end
